evidence: The About page is directly linked from the homepage navigation and visibly connects artistic, civic, technical, and social practice under “Systems people can inhabit,” satisfying the two-click requirement without displacing the technical project management and implementation positioning.

The Open House continuity establishes experimentation, communal decision-making, public participation, and many-perspective documentation through a bounded public source while explicitly preserving collective governance.
WOW List traces community language and distributed organizer practices into followable keyword communities, publishing workflows, calendars, and digests that organizers could use and continue.

Sunday Dinner / 196 traces hospitality, trust, invitations, onboarding, access handoffs, minimal documentation, and follow-up into repeatable participation infrastructure while withholding participant-level records.

NYC Artist Coalition / FairRentNYC traces listening, recurring meetings, public testimony, source maps, question logs, campaign interfaces, and action trackers into a civic system collaborators could influence, inspect, remember, and carry forward.

Source-Backed Team Memory extends the same inhabited-systems principle through contestable records, correction paths, explicit human review, source custody, and handoffs rather than automated authority.

The rendered About screenshots preserve a clear professional hierarchy: role and operating practice lead, while the artistic and social lineage appears as supporting explanation rather than an artist biography.

Collective attribution is explicit across the portfolio: WOW List is described as co-built, Sunday Dinner names community and co-organizer context, and coalition outcomes remain collective rather than being assigned solely to Jamie.
gaps: The supplied screenshots render only the upper portion of the About page, so the full continuity comparison is established primarily by the supplied page text rather than a complete-page About capture.
Open House is summarized on the About page rather than presented as a dedicated captured case-study surface; the public-safe source note provides the necessary provenance and limits.
safety_findings: No protected UCSC educational record, faculty testimonial, private correspondence, or unapproved praise is quoted or projected.

Sunday Dinner / 196 withholds participant identities, contacts, attendance histories, correspondence, addresses, access details, proposals, and unapproved images while publishing only aggregate or reconstructed workflow evidence.

Coalition materials distinguish public evidence from protected legal-review context, stakeholder information, private strategy, and shared-account authorship; causal and sole-credit claims are expressly bounded.
The colophon clearly identifies named-perspective reviews as fictionalized simulations that cannot grant consent, endorsement, approval, collective credit, or publication authority.
Image authorization is narrowly bounded to reviewed portfolio occurrences and does not claim depicted-person endorsement, broader reuse, or indexing approval.
recommendation: Pass. The candidate makes a concise, public-safe threshold visible within one click of the homepage and supports it with more than three concrete continuities showing systems that people can inhabit, influence, remember, and continue, while keeping the target professional role dominant.
